results.title: Deutsche Telekom stock faces Huawei fight over tougher 5G rules
results.snippet: Germany's government was also reported to be preparing a broader Huawei ban. Such a step could force operators to replace more equipment, increase capital requirements and complicate network planning. The financial effect for Deutsche Telekom would depend on the final rules, the timetable and the extent to which existing infrastructure could remain in service.
